text: 2026年11月10日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同斯洛伐克外长布拉纳尔会谈。王毅表示，中斯传统友好。近年来，在两国领导人共同引领下，中斯战略伙伴关系保持高位运行，各领域合作取得积极成果，成为大小不同、制度不同国家友好相处、平等相待、合作共赢的范例。中斯有广泛共同理念和共同利益，中方愿同斯方一道，进一步巩固政治互信，加强战略协调，充分释放合作潜力，以更高质量、更高水平双边关系为中欧关系健康发展及世界和平稳定作出贡献。 (外交部网站)
text_en: On November 10, 2026, Wang Yi, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, held talks in Beijing with Slovak Foreign Minister Juraj Blanár. Wang Yi said that China and Slovakia enjoy traditional friendship. In recent years, under the joint guidance of the leaders of both countries, the China-Slovakia strategic partnership has maintained a high level of performance, and cooperation in various fields has achieved positive results, becoming a model of friendly coexistence, equal treatment and win-win cooperation between countries of different sizes and different systems. China and Slovakia share extensive common ideas and common interests. China is willing to work with Slovakia to further consolidate political mutual trust, strengthen strategic coordination, fully unleash cooperation potential, and contribute to the healthy development of China-Europe relations and world peace and stability through higher-quality and higher-level bilateral relations. (Ministry of Foreign Affairs website)
